sections.summary: Automatic inclusion of Reels placements as part of Advantage+ placements.

claims.text: Advantage+ placements can run automatically, and when it is on, Reels ads are included in campaigns without manual placement selection.

evidence.locator: when Advantage+ placements is automatically on, we'll include Reels ads in your campaigns

sections.summary: Automation replaces manual Reels placement selection.

claims.text: With Advantage+ placements automatically on, Reels ads are added to campaigns without the advertiser selecting Reels manually.

evidence.locator: when Advantage+ placements is automatically on, we'll include Reels ads in your campaigns

sections.summary: No explicit use cases in evidence; inferred from automatic inclusion.

claims.text: Advertisers who want their ads to run in Reels placements without managing placements individually could rely on this automatic inclusion, assuming standard delivery goals apply.

evidence.locator: when Advantage+ placements is automatically on, we'll include Reels ads in your campaigns

sections.summary: The evidence states only that automatic Advantage+ placements includes Reels; it does not document the settings path or steps to enable it.
The packet provides no metrics, results, or performance data for this feature.
The packet contains no evidence about alternative or comparable features on other platforms.
